# unifi_switch_lags (Data Source)

Lists switch link-aggregation groups (LAGs) on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List switch link-aggregation groups (LAGs) on the site (Official API).
# The singular unifi_switch_lag data source fetches one by id.
data "unifi_switch_lags" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing switch LAGs.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `lags` (Attributes List) The switch LAGs defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lags))

<a id="nestedatt--lags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the LAG.
- `json` (String) The full LAG details serialized as a JSON string.
- `members` (Attributes List) The LAG members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lags--members))
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the LAG entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `type` (String) The LAG type (e.g. `LOCAL`, `MC_LAG`, `SWITCH_STACK`).

<a id="nestedatt--lags--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lags.members`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) The UUID of the member device.
- `port_idxs` (List of Number) The aggregated port indexes on the member device.
